extension.summary: Blurred backgrounds, online ratings, spoiler-free stills, keymaps and faster info pages for the Bald skin.
extension.description: A small service for the Bald skin. While Bald is the active skin and its blurred background is on, it blurs the fanart of the item Bald's background follows and keeps the results in a small cache, so Bald no longer needs TMDb Helper for its backgrounds. While Bald is the active skin and Bald Settings, Appearance, Behavior, "Open TV shows on their info page" is on, it installs a keymap so that Select on a TV show in the video library opens the show's information page instead of its seasons. It removes the keymap when the setting is off, under any other skin, and when Kodi exits or the add-on is disabled. It also runs Bald's information page, episode playback, More like this, Series page and letter bar actions in its running service, so they no longer start a new Python script each time; without the add-on Bald runs them as scripts as before. With an MDbList API key (free at mdblist.com; enter it in this add-on's settings), it looks up the IMDb, TMDb, Trakt, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic, Letterboxd, Roger Ebert, MyAnimeList and MDbList ratings of the movie or TV show Bald shows and of the playing movie, keeps them in a small cache and stays within MDbList's daily limit. It also lists the cast of the playing library item for Bald's player cast panel. With Bald Settings, Appearance, Information, "Hide spoilers for unwatched items" on, it keeps small frosted copies of the stills of unwatched episodes that Bald shows in their place; watched episodes are removed, and turning the setting off deletes them all.
